name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: A quiet request in Stormwind draws you to Bishop DeLavey at Stormwind Keep. The Church and crown need help with a matter too perilous for public channels.

sections.title: A Quiet Summons
sections.body: As you travel through Stormwind, Thomas, an altar boy, approaches with a quiet request. Bishop DeLavey, a respected cleric of the Church of the Holy Light, needs an outsider's help at Stormwind Keep. He calls the matter delicate and urgent. You must keep it discreet, lest the people panic.

sections.title: Whispers in the Keep
sections.body: At Stormwind Keep, Bishop DeLavey tells you why the matter must stay secret: a high-ranking kingdom dignitary has vanished under mysterious circumstances. Domestic unrest is brewing, and King Varian Wrynn is missing. Any sign of foul play among the kingdom's highest ranks could threaten its fragile peace.

faq.answer: Thomas is an altar boy at the Cathedral of Light who runs errands for Bishop DeLavey. He watches for capable adventurers on Stormwind's streets and directs them to the keep when Church or state affairs need discreet help.

Bishop DeLavey is a senior cleric of the Church of the Holy Light at Stormwind Keep. He works with the royal court on discreet security concerns and sensitive inquiries that city guards cannot openly pursue.

faq.q: Why is this matter handled in secret?
faq.answer: Stormwind is already uneasy: King Varian Wrynn is missing, and the Defias Brotherhood is stirring rebellion across Westfall. News that another prominent diplomat or official has vanished could spread panic or expose weaknesses at court.
The inquiry begins with Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep. It leads through Stormwind and the surrounding human territories, then into dangerous lands across the sea.
Bishop DeLavey keeps the diplomat's identity secret at the start of the inquiry. Revealing it could threaten the investigation and endanger the missing official and the kingdom.

angles.text: Finding the missing diplomat matters to the Alliance's integrity and defense. The inquiry may expose threats within Stormwind's own court.
As a human of Stormwind, you face a matter tied to your homeland's stability during a fragile regency.
